notes:
• Numbered lists restart after a normal paragraph, and nested items are
  numbered a. b. c. / i. ii. iii. like in Figma.
• Text boxes break onto exactly the lines Figma shows – read from what Figma
  draws, so it also matches text laid out on another machine or with an
  older version of the font, and lines that only just fit.
• The installer warns if an older copy of the panel is left somewhere it
  can't replace (After Effects could open that one instead), and shows it.
• Copy diagnostics shows the build and how each text box's lines were set.
